findings.detail: economic_unsellable_recovery_floor=0.1 is present in freeze but never applied in src/labels_exec.py (confirmed by repo grep). NO_FILL rows keep wallet_pnl=NaN.
NO_FILL rows are NaN/0, not charged stake*(floor-1). Mitigated only because selection requires buy_status==SUCCESS.

Panel censored flag comes from actor-resolution FIFO transfer-out logic; labels_exec still marks price-path SUCCESS and assigns full TP-ladder PnL. FIFO episodes.parquet uses NaN pnl when censored, but copy-sim labels do not.
Shared-infra/solver tier-D rows should not be scorable copy subjects.

episode_cross_check.detail: FIFO episodes correctly NaN pnl when censored; identity scores exclude them.

summary.materiality_for_whale_scorecard: Selection requires buy_status==SUCCESS, so NO_FILL NaNs do not enter WHALE totals. Main residual risk: censored transfer-out buys that still receive optimistic price-path PnL in wallet_pnl_weth, and recovery_floor never applied.
